title: Kylie Lim shows off her figure while holidaying with James Packer
text:
By MARTA JARY, SHOWBUSINESS NIGHT EDITOR, AUSTRALIA

Published:  17:43 AEST, 3 September 2026   |  Updated:  19:00 AEST, 3 September 2026

Kylie Lim has been kicking back and enjoying married life after her secret wedding with her new billionaire husband, James Packer.

The model was flaunting her fit figure after taking a dip off Packer's mega yacht on Wednesday.

The 46-year-old did a little snorkelling in the crystal clear water, while Packer dined with friends.

Kylie opted for a fitted, cream swimsuit that showcased her ample bust and sat close to her gym-honed physique.

After her dip, she lay back and dried off while catching some rays on a comfortable sun lounge.

The brunette appeared to go makeup-free for her swim and wore her locks down on her shoulders.

Kylie Lim (pictured) has been kicking back and enjoying married life after her secret wedding with her new billionaire husband, James Packer

The pair tied the knot in an intimate ceremony off the coast of Sardinia, Italy, early last month.

The couple reportedly hosted around 30 family members and close friends for the cocktail-style wedding.

After leaving the popular Spanish island, Packer's superyacht IJE was spotted off Sardinia's Costa Smeralda region.

It is believed to be Lim's first marriage, while Packer, 58, has been married twice.

They confirmed their engagement in March, following reports the New York socialite had been seen wearing a diamond ring while running errands in Aspen, Colorado.

'We are very happy to be engaged and looking forward to the future,' Packer told news.com.au.

The pair were together for almost three years from late 2017 to 2020 before rekindling their romance last year.

Packer has a long history of romances with a bevy of beauties.

His first marriage was to model Jodhi Meares, with the pair tying the knot at his home in Bellevue Hill, Sydney, in October 1999.

They were only married for two years before separating in 2002.

He later married model and singer Erica Baxter in a civil ceremony at Hotel du Cap – Eden Roc in Cap d'Antibes on the French Riviera in June 2007, before calling time on their marriage in September 2013.

The pair share three children: Indigo, 18, Jackson, 16, and Emmanuelle, 13 - and are still on close terms.

He was also engaged to former Aussie model Kate Fischer for two years before they split in 1998.

His most high-profile relationship was with US pop star Mariah Carey.

The pair shocked the world by getting engaged in January 2016, but split just months later in October, with the American diva receiving a multi-million dollar settlement from the billionaire.
